hero.eyebrow: Micro-label above main heading (e.g., 'Direct access, no account layer'). Max 6 words.

h1.h1-text: Primary role and location heading prefix (e.g., 'Hire a Machine Learning Engineer in {{CITY}}:'). Must include {{CITY}}.
h1.span: Specialisation or core value proposition suffix (e.g., 'custom ML models & production MLOps'). Max 5-8 words.

hero.hero-sub: Introductory paragraph explaining what the specialist builds and deploys for businesses in {{CITY}} and {{STATE}}. Exactly 2-3 sentences.

cred.b: Metric highlight text (e.g., '5+ years building ML', '12+ case studies', '48h written spec'). Max 4 words.

btn-primary.text: Action-oriented primary CTA button text (e.g., 'Discuss your ML project'). Max 4 words.

btn-ghost.text: Secondary ghost CTA button text (e.g., 'View 12 case studies'). Max 4 words.

hero.live: Trust note on meeting logistics, response time, and NDA protection in {{CITY}}. Max 1 sentence.
